subject: POC plan & final readout scheduling - NovaCare Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + proposed POC plan (next steps)

Hi Sara -

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference for NovaCare's chart summarization pipeline at 250-500 concurrent patients with <300ms median token latency.
- Key success criteria: (1) summary accuracy >= 92% on the clinical evaluation set, (2) end-to-end latency within SLO, (3) integration with your S3 staging data and KMS for keys.
- Stakeholders: Tom (tech lead), Andre (VP Eng) for exec sign-off, Sara for product/clinical acceptance.

Proposed 3-week POC plan (timeline & ownership)
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + environment access (owner: Tom & Marcus).
- Week 1: Baseline run with sample dataset, configure model & quantization profile (owner: Marcus/Neha).
- Week 2: Integration run (end-to-end), run evaluation harness and capture metrics (owner: Tom/Marissa).
- Week 3: Final readout + exec decision (date options below) (owner: Sara + Andre for decision).

Attachments: I've attached the POC scope and success criteria spreadsheet and our trial terms for your legal/infosec review.

Scheduling: Please let me know which final readout date works best for the exec review: March 2 (Wed) 10:00-10:30am PT, March 3 (Thu) 9:00-9:30am PT, or March 4 (Fri) 11:00-11:30am PT. We'll allocate Marcus + Neha + Marissa for the demo and a 15-20 minute Q&A for Andre.

Action items after this email:
- Sara/Tom: confirm environment access & AD group for S3 read access (by Wed EOD).
- NovaCare: confirm preferred final readout slot (by Fri).
- Redwood: stand up trial tenant and upload sample eval harness (Marcus/Neha).

Appreciate it - I'll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm the slot.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: novacare_poc_scope.pdf] [Attachment: novacare_success_criteria.xlsx]

Thanks Marcus - this is great and matches what we discussed. A few quick notes:

- Final readout: March 3 at 9:00am PT works for Andre and me.

I'll loop Tom for the creds and he'll coordinate with infra. Looking forward to the baseline run.

Best,
